frozen_before: any A33-R3 code, any A33-R3 holdout evaluation, any A33-R3 surface
lane: GEMSDOE33 analog-field / cover-stratified hydrothermal transfer lane (continuation of A33-R2-CSHT next steps (i)-(iii) recorded in knowledge/13)
evidence_labels: Every performance number is HOLDOUT-DTI (evaluator gems-segment-pooled-v1, n withheld positives, 10 km block-bootstrap 95% CI) or ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED (receipt). Historical leaderboard figures are USER/OWNER-REPORTED. No projections are written as scores.

hypotheses_ranked.name: Line-Localized CSHT: label-free oriented scarp line-integral evidence x cover/hydrothermal CSHT prior, regime-split at lid_valid
hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: Multi-scale Hessian bright-ridge strength (sigma 1 and 2 px, scale-normalised, Steger 1998 / Frangi 1998) of a rank-averaged scarp-evidence field, integrated along 12 azimuths with an anisotropic Gaussian line kernel (sigma_long 5 px = 500 m, sigma_short 0.75 px), then 1-px non-maximum suppression across the winning azimuth. LiDAR regime (lid_valid>0) uses 1 m-derived scarp descriptors; LiDAR-void regime (lid_valid==0, 24.63% of footprint) uses det_elev_slope from the 100 m training stack.
hypotheses_ranked.why_missing_faults: Pixel classifiers trained on the incomplete catalogue rank broad zones; unmapped faults are typically short, low-relief scarps whose contrast is too weak per pixel. Integrating along strike accumulates weak but collinear evidence and puts dots on the trace (inside the 300 m kernel) instead of on zone centroids.
hypotheses_ranked.distinct_from_prior_art: A33-R2-CSHT had no line localisation (pixel HGB + CELF); A33-L1/H33-F were analog-level transfers; H19-5/B2 is a fixed, externally produced ridge emission that this lane never reads. LLC fuses a label-free line likelihood with the fold-trained CSHT prior.
hypotheses_ranked.named_non_fault_mimic: Pluvial Lake Lahontan wave-cut shorelines/beach ridges (highstand ~1338 m; Adams & Wesnousky 1998, GSA Bulletin 110(10):1318) and fluvial terrace risers / linear anthropogenic cuts, which are long, straight, scarp-like lines.
hypotheses_ranked.expected_improvement_rank: highest (qualitative; no numeric DTI gain is claimed before measurement)

hypotheses_ranked.name: Structural-grain conformity prior
layers: fold-visible catalogue (doubled-angle orientation tensor, sigma 15 km)
hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: cos^2 of the angle between local scarp strike and the regional mapped-fault grain
hypotheses_ranked.why_missing_faults: Basin-and-Range faults within a structural domain are sub-parallel; unmapped strands should share the domain grain.
hypotheses_ranked.distinct_from_prior_art: no orientation-conformity weighting exists in GEMSDOE33
hypotheses_ranked.named_non_fault_mimic: bedding-parallel lithologic ledges that share the regional grain

hypotheses_ranked.name: Magnetic-basement tilt-derivative zero-crossing worms beneath basin fill
hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: tilt-angle zero contours at two continuation heights restricted to deep cover
hypotheses_ranked.why_missing_faults: GeoDAWN magnetics image basement offsets concealed by alluvium where no scarp exists
hypotheses_ranked.distinct_from_prior_art: not in GEMSDOE33, but GEMSDOE76 'tiltworm' (user-reported 0.2343) is close prior art, so raster-level duplicate risk is high
hypotheses_ranked.named_non_fault_mimic: edges of magnetic volcanic flows / intrusive contacts

hypotheses_ranked.name: Lahontan shoreline rejection test (iso-elevation chain rejection)
layers: absolute elevation DEM (NOT in pinned inputs; det_elev is detrended)
hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: reject scarp chains whose along-chain absolute elevation variance is ~0 near the 1318-1341 m highstand band
hypotheses_ranked.why_missing_faults: removes the main intrabasin mimic so the dot budget goes to real scarps
hypotheses_ranked.distinct_from_prior_art: 62GEMSDOE used Lahontan as a strain datum, not as a mimic filter

frozen_protocol.registry: registry/focus_rasters_20261026_r3.json = pinned 21-raster focus registry + this repo's A33-R2-CSHT artifact (22 rasters)
frozen_protocol.line_evidence: L_line = within-regime percentile rank of oriented line integral, multiplied by the 1-px NMS mask (0 off-line)
order_of_operations: 1. leakage canary (SegmentHoldout.canary, quadrant 15 px) on every new channel alone; any two-sided AUC > 0.90 = stop

2. full-footprint surfaces for V1 and V2; pre-placement surface uniqueness vs 22 registry rasters (|Spearman| <= 0.90 AND top-37,654 eligible level-set 3-px overlap <= 70%); failing variants are logged duplicate and dropped

3. Experiment 1/3 screen: quadrant-buffered-15px-v1; surviving variants + in-run A33-R2-CSHT recipe + B1_regional + matched_random; informational non-fold-safe H19-5 recipe reference (fixed external surface; NOT a gate)
4. select the surviving variant with the highest screen pooled HOLDOUT-DTI
5. Experiment 2/3 confirmation: diagonal-wedge-buffered-20px-confirm-v1, selected variant vs in-run CSHT and B1
6. Experiment 3/3 reserved, unused unless a shared-tool defect forces a rerun
7. full-footprint CELF-300m placement (37,654 dots, d_cat > 2 px, min self spacing 2.5 px), final-dot uniqueness, writer, saved-byte format audit, promotion assessment
frozen_protocol.placement: csht_transfer.celf_emit_300m(min_self_spacing_px=2.5), eligible = valid & distance_to_visible_catalogue > 2 px, per-fold budget = round(37654 * valid/footprint)
promotion_gate_all_required: screen pooled HOLDOUT-DTI > max(in-run CSHT, recorded CSHT 0.136716, in-run B1)
screen paired delta vs in-run CSHT 95% CI strictly > 0 and >= 3/4 fold wins
confirmation pooled HOLDOUT-DTI > max(in-run CSHT, recorded CSHT confirm 0.131169)
confirmation paired delta vs in-run CSHT 95% CI strictly > 0 and >= 3/4 fold wins
surface and final-dot uniqueness pass vs all 22 registry rasters
saved-byte format audit pass (1 band float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, template transform, finite [0,1], 0 NaN in zero-outside file)
frozen_protocol.verdict_rule: promote only if every gate passes; duplicate if any uniqueness check fails; leakage if any canary fails; otherwise negative. Negative results are deliverables. No retuning after seeing holdout results.
frozen_protocol.slot_policy: No DrivenData upload from code. A promote verdict means OK-TO-SUBMIT for the owner's separate selector step within the weekly cap shown on the submission page.
